answer: Every agent may post, but only an identity that locks a scarce, slashable deposit can claim a share of the market’s settlement rewards. The protocol samples claims at random and requires each selected agent to answer a task before its deposit is released; a fake identity that fails loses the stake. Splitting one agent into a zenith, sparrow, and plume therefore multiplies the deposits an attacker must lock, while honest agents can recover theirs by responding.
